monitored_text: Protolabs Product Release Notes Discover our latest product releases, capability enhancements, and e-commerce upgrades *United States only Year 2026 2025 2024 2023 Month All January February March April May June July August September October November December Service Line expand_less expand_more View All 3D Printing close CNC Machining close Injection Molding close Sheet Metal Fabrication close Platform expand_less expand_more MyRapid close Protolabs close Quoting Platform close Expand All expand_all Collapse All collapse_all No release notes match the selected filter combination. June 30, 2026 3D Printing Protolabs New 3D Printing Materials Available: ABS‑Like Value + Medical White More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We’re expanding our 3D printing material lineup with two new options designed to support both ends of the development spectrum, from fast, early-stage iteration to more specialized application needs. Together, these additions give you greater flexibility in how you prototype and refine your designs. What’s New ABS‑Like Value Material A cost-effective option optimized for early-stage prototyping and rapid iteration: Produce low-cost parts ideal for concept development Evaluate basic form and fit before design refinement Receive parts in a standard blue color for easy identification Learn more about ABS-Like Value → Medical White for Advanced Photopolymers A high-quality material designed for applications requiring a clean, white finish and enhanced presentation: Achieve a smooth, bright white appearance Create parts suitable for detailed prototypes and visual models Support applications where clarity and finish matter Maintain consistent quality across complex geometries Learn more about Medical White → These new materials expand your options at both the early and more refined stages of development, making it easier to move from concept to evaluation with the right material at each step. April 21, 2026 Protolabs Enhanced Order Tracking for Split Shipments More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We’ve introduced a new enhancement that provides full visibility into orders that ship in multiple batches. When an order is split into multiple shipments, you can now view detailed information for each individual shipment—right from your order history. What's New You will now see shipment‑level details for every partial shipment in your order, including: Ship date PO number Quantity shipped Release date FedEx tracking information Shipping destination February 23, 2026 CNC Machining Protolabs Introducing Faster Lead Times for Advanced Milling Capabilities More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We are excited to announce a major improvement to our CNC Milling service: Lead times for select advanced capabilities are now as fast as 4 days. This enhancement allows you to turn around complex, production relevant parts faster than ever—without sacrificing quality, consistency, or inspection rigor. What's New Improved 4-day lead times for advanced options. The following capabilities are now eligible for accelerated manufacturing: Surface Finishes Anodize Type II Black Anodize Type II Clear Chromate Tolerancing & Functional Features General Tolerance Tightest Feature Tolerance Tapping Class of Fits (custom fits for functional mating components) Quality Documentation & Inspection Dimensional Inspection Report Basic Inspection Report Certificate of Conformance Material Certificate of Analysis (CoA) Part Identification & Marking Ink Stamp Engraving (non-serialized) These upgrades apply to a wide range of metal and plastic materials and are designed to accelerate your development cycles while maintaining Protolabs’ high quality standards. The accelerated 4-day lead time option is available now in the Protolabs quoting experience for eligible CNC milled parts and materials. Start a Project! Get a Quote February 17, 2026 Quoting Platform Introducing ProDesk by Protolabs More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up ProDesk is your go-to digital manufacturing resource to accelerate prototype and production projects from start to finish. The intuitive platform elevates the tasks you do most: get quotes fast, reorder with ease, connect with production experts, access recent activity, and stay up to date on the latest platform enhancements. Simply put: ProDesk is your smarter home for more efficient work. Learn More December 16, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs Filter 3D Printing Materials by Color More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Now available - filter your 3D printing material options by color. While using our 3D printing materials tool, use the color filter on the left navigation pane to constrain your desired material list. Color filters options include gray, green, black, natural, translucent, and more. See 3D Printing Material Color Options December 10, 2025 Quoting Platform Production Catalog Sharing More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Collaboration in manufacturing just got simpler. You can now share your Production Catalog directly within your Protolabs account—making it easier than ever to keep your team in sync and your parts production-ready. With Production Catalog sharing, your team can: Instantly view and reorder approved parts Access order history, documentation, and part details Stay aligned with consistent part data across projects Streamline your production workflow—and bring your team closer to every part. Explore What's New November 10, 2025 Quoting Platform Introducing Order Sharing More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Keep your team aligned from order to delivery. Order Sharing makes it simple to collaborate on active and past orders so nothing gets missed when roles shift. Easily share orders with team members Monitor order status, track shipments, and reorder Access to available quality and order documentation Transfer order history to new team members to maintain continuity Get a Quote October 30, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs Vapor Smoothing now available for MJF PA 12 Natural More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up To add vapor smoothing to your PA 12 parts, choose that material then select vapor smoothing through the “finish” drop down menu. Learn More about Vapor Smoothing September 23, 2025 Injection Molding Protolabs Improved Quality & Speed with In-House Heat Staking More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up All heat staking for molded parts is now done in house, allowing unmatched consistency and quality with the ability to expedite shipping. Learn More September 22, 2025 Injection Molding Quoting Platform Improved Inspections for Injection Molded Parts More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Ordering injection molding inspections just got simpler! If your part requires inspections outside of a CTQ, Partial FAI, Capability Study, or PPAP, you can now request them under Additional Inspections in our online platform. Learn More September 15, 2025 Protolabs Quoting Platform Protolabs Support Center More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Introducing the Protolabs Support Center—your one-stop hub for help with orders, documents, changes, billing, and quality. Reach us however you prefer: submit a support request, call, chat, or email for quick assistance. Prefer to self-serve? Explore our Design Guides for each service line to troubleshoot on your own. Preview Support Center September 08, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs Quoting Platform New Custom Finishing Option for Plastic 3D Printed Parts: Laser Engraving More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Now offering laser engraving on 3D printed plastic parts, enabling permanent, high-contrast markings such as logos, IDs, and text. Learn more about custom finishing options for 3D printed parts September 03, 2025 CNC Machining Protolabs Quoting Platform Expansion of CNC Capabilities, now Accepting Technical Drawings More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We are excited to announce the launch of new advanced options in our CNC Machining service, available now on our e-commerce platform. These enhancements are designed to provide our customers with greater flexibility and customization to meet their specific project requirements. Below are the details of the new features New Features Tolerances: Customers can now upload a technical drawing that adheres to linear tolerances of ISO 2768-1-1989-f, Standard hole tolerances quoted to +/- 0.005 in. and Hole & bore-style tolerance on specified features may be +/- 0.0005 in. Class of Fits: A selection of classes of fits is now available, enabling customers to define the relationship between mating parts. This helps in achieving optimal assembly and performance. Inserts: We now offer a variety of insert options. Includes helicoil, key inserts, dowel pins and PEM inserts. Part Markings: Enhance traceability and identification with part marking options. This feature allows for adding text, logos and other identifiers directly onto parts. Coatings: Now offering 30 coating and plating options. Choose from anodizing, chromate coating, powder coating, zinc coating, and nickle plating. Inspections & Certificates: To ensure the highest quality, customers can select from different levels of inspection services such as FAIs, AS9102, and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) documentation. Availability: These features are available immediately to all users of our CNC machining service. Simply log in to your account and upload a part to take advantage of the enhanced customization. Upload a Part August 06, 2025 Quoting Platform Explore our Production Catalog More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Streamline your transition from prototyping to full-scale production effortlessly. Our Production Catalog allows you to manage, organize, and reorder your production-ready parts efficiently, eliminating complications. Customers can now identify specific parts to be added to the Production Catalog, which team members can then access for easy reordering. Elevate your production workflow today May 16, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs New Material: Flame Retardant Black More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up A new material has been added to our advanced photopolymer list, now offering Flame Retardant Black (Arkema FR512). This material utilizes our HPS process and is a flame-retardant resin that achieves a UL-94 rating of V-0 at 0.031 in. while maintaining good print accuracy with fine feature parts. This material will replace Carbon EPX86 FR that will be discontinued on May 30th. Learn more about Flame Retardant Black April 22, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs Discontinuation of RPU70 Material More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up As part of our ongoing efforts to streamline our 3D printing product line and ensure the highest quality materials are available, we have decided to discontinue the RPU70 material effective April 15th. We understand that RPU70 has been integral to many of your projects, and we want to assure you that we have a suitable alternative ready for your future orders. Our Tough Black (Loctite Henkel 3843) material is an excellent substitute, offering similar properties that cater to your needs for durability and strength. Compare 3D Printing Materials April 01, 2025 Injection Molding Protolabs Add Custom Inspections to Your Molding Project More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Our digitalized processes, scientific molding, and quality measures ensure both repeatability and quality. We now offer a variety of inspection reports you can easily select within your Protolabs account. Customizing inspections for your injection molding project allows for verification of numerous critical dimensions and gives you peace of mind. You’re able to select the desired number of features and samples you’d like measured. Check out the help center to learn more about adding inspections to your project. Learn More March 26, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs New Material: PA12 Value More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up New material option added to our Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) process called PA12 Value. PA12 Value is a great alternative to PA12 White, providing an off-white colored part with similar properties but at a lower price point. PA12 Value is a great option when your project requires functional and durable parts with no added finishing. Upload a Part February 25, 2025 Injection Molding Protolabs ABS Lustran Update More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up On October 30, 2024, Ineos Styrolution announced their intention to permanently close their Addyston, Ohio operations. As of now, we have received notification of the discontinuation of Lustran branded ABS materials. Our team is here to support you in identifying alternative materials and solutions to ensure continuity in your production. Here is the latest information on recommended material alternatives. February 25, 2025 Quoting Platform Easier Iterative Design with Part Renaming More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We know that designing the perfect part often takes multiple revisions - new CAD files, adjustments, and refinements until you reach the final version. To make this process smoother, we've added a Rename Parts feature inside eCommerce. Keep track of different iterations by renaming parts as you refine the design Avoid confusion by giving your final CAD file a clear, meaningful name Stay organized while working through multipole design updates. February 25, 2025 3D Printing Protolabs New Custom Finishing for 3D Printed Parts: Cerakote More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Adding to our extensive list of custom finishing options for 3D printed parts, we've recently added Cerakote. Cerakote is a ceramic coating that can be applied to 3D printed parts in varying materials providing superior performance and functionality. It is also available in a wide array of colors. Cerakote can be used as an alternative to anodizing and painting providing a wide range of benefits on finished parts. To evaluate the full list of Cerakote coatings visit here . How to Order Parts with Cerakote Finishing Step 1: In your quote configuration, select "custom" from the finish drop-down menu. From here you will be prompted to describe what type of finish you are looking for. This is where you will put coating selection from here . Step 2: By adding a request for custom finishing, this will trigger a manual review of a quote and an applications engineer will reach out to you to learn more about your part requirements and provide recommendations on a path forward. Step 3: You will receive a link that will bring you to a final quote that includes the custom finishing required. Place your order and wait for your custom finished parts to arrive! December 17, 2024 3D Printing Protolabs Vapor smoothing now available for SLS PA 12 Black and SLS PA 12 Mineral-Filled More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up To add vapor smoothing to your PA 12 Black and PA 12 Mineral-Filled parts, simply select that material and add vapor smoothing through the "Finish" drop down. Learn more about vapor smoothing November 25, 2024 Injection Molding Protolabs Improved Customer-Supplied Materials Table More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Exciting updates have been made to the Customer-Supplied Materials Table in the Profile and Settings section of e-commerce. With these enhancements, finding the materials needed is now faster and more intuitive. Whether managing projects or placing orders, the process has been streamlined to improve the user experience and overall efficiency on the platform. Log in today to explore the improvements and enjoy easier navigation and management of materials. Sign In October 28, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication Protolabs MyRapid Easily compare prices between quantities 1 to 100 More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Easily compare unit and total prices from quantities 1 to 100 on any sheet metal part. Click "compare pricing" on the part summary tile of your quote to see the breakdown. Add new quantities and click directly on a specific quantity to update the pricing on your quote. Compare Quantity Pricing October 14, 2024 CNC Machining Protolabs New feature to help you prioritize project needs; fast or economical - you decide More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up A new feature has been added to CNC machining’s manufacturing analysis within eCommerce that let’s you easily decide between if you need your part fast, or as you designed without machining compromise. Now you have the choice whether you're on a tight schedule or a tight budget, selecting between lead times and price is now only one click away. Upload a Part Now on eligible parts, within the Material Left Behind advisory you will have two options to select from Select your choice and hit next. Once you return to your quote the new price and lead time options will be available based on your selection. September 16, 2024 3D Printing Protolabs Now Offering Advanced Photopolymers More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up A new category, Advanced Photopolymers, has been added to our material selection dropdown with two brand new materials; Ceramic-filled and Tough Black. These two materials use our newly launched HPS process providing excellent resolution and higher mechanical properties for more advanced/end-use applications. Learn More about Advanced Photopolymers August 30, 2024 Injection Molding Protolabs Easily Add Inspections to Your Injection Molding Order More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We perform quality checks on your parts throughout the manufacturing process. We now have two critical-to-quality inspections as a configurable option for you to select within e-commerce. Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) - CTQ Partial FAI (First Article Inspection) - Includes a 3-part dimensional first article inspection of critical features (5 features maximum) with no impact to lead time. - CTQ Capability Study - Includes a 30-part dimensional capability study of critical features (5 features maximum) with no impact to lead time. In addition, we provide a wide range of other quality documentation. Compare the benefits of each inspection report to see which is best suited for your project needs. Learn more August 13, 2024 3D Printing Protolabs Now offering PA12 Black in Selective Laser Sintering More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We've added SLS PA12 Black to our extensive list of plastic materials available through our 3D printing service. PA12 Black parts are highly isotropic with great dimensional accuracy without sacrificing mechanical consistency, making it a great material for enclosures, snap fits and hinges. Compare 3D printing materials August 09, 2024 CNC Machining Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid .PRT Files are Now Accepted in MyRapid More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up MyRapid is now able to analyze native .PRT files for both sheet metal fabrication and precision CNC machining. Upload a Part August 05, 2024 Protolabs New "Shared with You" Quotes More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Are you trying to locate a quote that was shared with you? We have updated our user experience to make this task more straightforward. You can now find shared quotes in the 'Projects' sections of your account. July 08, 2024 Protolabs New Parts & Molds Page More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We made some recent improvements to our e-commerce platform that allows for a much better experience! Now, you can easily search, sort, and filter parts and molds right within your account. July 01, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Protolabs Faster CAD Uploading More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We've simplified the CAD upload process in order to get your quote created faster. Choose from material and finish options, and decide to have your 2D drawing reviewed after receiving your initial price and lead time. Upload a Part June 24, 2024 Injection Molding Protolabs Improved Polishing Capabilities Without Sacrificing Lead Time More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We are constantly looking for innovative ways to improve - with our new proprietary mill head auto polishing system, we can get customer products (parts) out the door faster. We now offer auto polishing of 65% of all mold surfaces, with continued focus to make that even more efficient in the future. We are ultimately producing higher quality finishes, saving labor time and costs. June 10, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication Protolabs MyRapid New Finishing Options Available for Sheet Metal Projects More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We have added new finishing options for sheet metal components & assemblies to provide further customization on your project. These finishes include: Wet paint (standalone finish or with primer) Gold & silver plating If you're unsure whether powder coating or wet paint is best for your next assembly project, our Applications Specialists are available for a free consultation. See Finishing Options May 15, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication Protolabs Sheet Metal Capability Enhancements More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up This series of enhancements includes: New finishing options such as wet paint, gold plating, and silver plating. Pre-plated steels (galvanized and galvannealed) available at a 3 day lead time. Compare Material Options May 10, 2024 CNC Machining Threading Options Now Available Through Factory and Network More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up When selecting threading, you'll now have the ability to select from Factory and Network pricing options when eligible, giving you more flexibility within your project requirement. Upload a Part April 29, 2024 Injection Molding Protolabs Injection Molding Colorant Update More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Effective April 29, some of our molding category material color names will be updated as follows in e-commerce and on our website: Thermoplastics will have OMNICOLOR® or UNICOLOR® in the corresponding colors' names. Silicone Rubber will have Silcopas® in the corresponding colors' names. Note: No formulation or color change has been made to any products. April 01, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Protolabs Share and Forward Sheet Metal Quotes More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Use the "Forward/Share" feature to allow other members of your organization to see and order your quotes. Upload a Part March 15, 2024 CNC Machining Instant Quotes for CNC Machining More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Instant quoting now available on select parts. See pricing and DFM instantly within the quote builder. In quote review easily select lead time and pricing options from the factory or network. Upload a Part March 05, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Protolabs Sheet Metal Material Thickness Feedback Update More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up A new feature allows for reviewing your designed part thickness compared to our closest available stocked sheet thickness. If your designed thickness is slightly different than the displayed material thickness, you're in good hands. With years of fabrication expertise under our belts, we have the know-how to ensure your final part meets your CAD dimensions. Note: Protolabs uses industry standard sheet metal material thicknesses between .024" and .250". Upload a Part February 20, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Introduction of Sheet Metal Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Analysis More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis is now available for all sheet metal components. Upon uploading your CAD file, we will automatically detect any potential manufacturability advisories such as features near bends, flange lengths, and hardware-to-material compatibility. See our DFM toolkit here . February 01, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Configurable Inspection Documentation More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Select inspection and quality documentation options directly on your sheet metal quote. Upload a Part February 01, 2024 CNC Machining Protolabs Expanded CNC 5-Axis Capability for Larger Parts More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Now offering 5-axis machining in larger part sizes. We can now support designs with off-axis features up to X-Y-Z part dimensions. Learn more about our CNC machining design guidelines here . January 24, 2024 3D Printing Protolabs Now offering Vapor smoothing for PA 11 Black More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Vapor smoothing, our newest finishing option for 3D printing is now available for PA 11 Black parts. To add vapor smoothing to your PA 11 Black parts, simply select the material with vapor smoothing on the material selector drop down. Learn more about vapor smoothing here . January 05, 2024 Sheet Metal Fabrication Protolabs Expanded Press Break Forming Capabilities at 3 Day Lead Times More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up We've expanded our form tooling and geometry capabilities to allow more designs to receive a 3 day lead time. Prior to this update, .030" was the lone qualifying tooling option. This change adds .060", .090", .120" tools. Designs with greater than 90 degree bend angles (up to 135 degrees) are newly eligible for a 3 day lead time. Note: maximum qualifying material thickness is .104" Check out our forming capabilities here . November 06, 2023 3D Printing Protolabs Vapor smoothing has moved More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Vapor smoothing can now be found under the "Finish" dropdown and no longer selectable from the material dropdown. The dropdown will only appear if an eligible material has been selected. Here is a full list of eligible materials; PA 11 Black, PA 12 Black, PA 12 White, PA 12 Glass Filled Black, PA 12 Glass Filled Natural, and TPU White and Black. November 06, 2023 3D Printing Protolabs Vapor smoothing now available for PA 12 40% GF Black and PA 12 40% GF More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up To add vapor smoothing to your PA 12 40% GF Black and PA 12 40% GF parts, simply select the material with vapor smoothing in the material selector drop down. Learn more about vapor smoothing here . September 04, 2023 3D Printing Protolabs New Material added for 3D printing More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Carbon EPX 86FR a flame-retardant resin that offers functional toughness, high strength and long-term stability added to our list of available materials for 3D printing technologies. For more specifics on Carbon EPX 86 FR can be found here . August 10, 2023 Injection Molding Protolabs Part Cleaning Now Available More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Part cleaning is now available inside e-commerce under secondary operations. Part cleaning includes washing or deep cleaning of parts by various methods, including ultrasonic cleaning, vapor degreasing, and ISO Class 7 clean room cleaning and packaging. June 05, 2023 Vapor smoothing now available for TPU white and black and PA 12 white More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up To add vapor smoothing to your TPU White and Black and PA 12 White parts, simply select the material with vapor smoothing in the material selector drop down. Learn more about vapor smoothing here . June 01, 2023 CNC Machining Protolabs Cost Efficient Machined Parts at Any Quantity More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Network pricing and ordering are now available on select machined parts within the Protolabs platform. If a part qualifies you'll be presented with standard, expedite, economy, and now network options. May 22, 2023 3D Printing Protolabs Vapor smoothing now available for PA 12 Black More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up To add vapor smoothing to your PA 12 Black parts, simply select the material with vapor smoothing in the material selector drop down. Learn more about vapor smoothing here . May 01, 2023 CNC Machining Protolabs New Aluminum Materials More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up New materials with material certifications added for CNC machining. Aluminum 2024 Aluminum 7075-T7 Compare materials properties here . April 23, 2023 CNC Machining Quick Turn Finishing Available in as Fast as 4 Days More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Quick turn anodizing and plating are now available on aluminum materials. Simply select your finish option from the coating drop-down on the configuration page. April 10, 2023 Protolabs Upload Part Inspection Drawings More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Now offering drawing intakes for scaled inspections. Customers can upload their inspection drawings online to identify critical features. January 30, 2023 Protolabs Schedule Design Reviews More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up You can now schedule design reviews online with a Protolabs Team Member for design feedback! Schedule Today January 23, 2023 CNC Machining New Lathe Groove Cutting Tools More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up New internal diameter groove cutting tools now available for soft metal lathe. January 23, 2023 3D Printing Protolabs Instant Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Instant design for additive manufacturability (DfAM) analysis now available on all 3D printed quotes. When reviewing your quote, our analysis will immediately highlight potential manufacturability advisories concerning thin walls, small gaps and parts that might exceed our maximum size restraints. For more help on designing for 3D Printing visit our toolkit . January 15, 2023 Injection Molding Protolabs 7-day lead time on small parts More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Now offering 7-day lead time on small parts (3 in. x 2.5 in.). Learn more January 10, 2023 Sheet Metal Fabrication MyRapid Identify Cosmetic Requirements on Sheet Metal Projects More Details expand_circle_down Less Details expand_circle_up Sheet metal quotes now include a way to designate your cosmetic finishing requirements. Choose between "standard" or "cosmetic" part processing based on the needs of your project. Note: a 2D drawing is required to accurately assess surface treatments and part location associated with cosmetic designs.
